Here are reliable places people commonly use to buy makeup online in **Saudi Arabia**, plus a few tips to avoid fakes and surprise customs fees.

## Major beauty retailers that deliver in Saudi Arabia
- **Sephora (Middle East / KSA)** – Wide range of prestige brands; fast local delivery in many areas.
- **Nice One** – Popular Saudi beauty e-commerce site with frequent discounts and large selection.
- **Golden Scent** – Strong on fragrances and beauty; ships across KSA.
- **Faces (Wojooh)** – Regional beauty retailer with many mainstream and prestige brands.
- **Boutiqaat** – Often has bundles and influencer-curated selections; delivery to KSA.

## Big marketplaces (good selection, but vet sellers)
- **Amazon.sa** – Convenient shipping/returns; check that the seller is Amazon or an authorized store.
- **Noon (KSA)** – Large catalog and frequent deals; prefer “Noon Express”/trusted sellers.

## Brand-direct stores (best for authenticity)
If you already know the brand you want (e.g., **MAC, Huda Beauty, NARS, Fenty Beauty**), buying from the **official brand site** (or the brand’s official store on a marketplace) is the safest way to avoid counterfeit items.

## Tips to shop safely in KSA
- Prefer **authorized retailers** and “sold by / fulfilled by” options on marketplaces.
- Be cautious with prices that are *far* below normal—counterfeits are common with popular items.
- Check the **return policy** for opened cosmetics and the **delivery time** (especially for perfumes/aerosols).

If you tell me your **city (e.g., Riyadh/Jeddah/Dammam)** and whether you want **luxury brands vs. budget**, I can narrow it down to the best 3–5 options and what each is best for.
